      writeFile in interface FileProtocol
      Overrides:
      writeFile in class ProjectFile

    • ifAnyNull

      private static void ifAnyNull(String errStr, String id, String label, int code, SceneObject... objs)
      Checks if any of the provided SceneObjects are null. If a null object is found, it handles a ProjectFileException indicating a corrupted file. This is typically used during file reading to ensure all referenced objects exist.
      Parameters:
      errStr - A string describing the type of object being checked (e.g., "tri", "curve").
      id - The ID of the main object that references the potentially null objects.
      label - A string describing the type of referenced object (e.g., "point", "line").
      code - The error code to associate with the ProjectFileException.
      objs - A variable argument list of SceneObjects to check for null.
